items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: It was somebody like Judy Gollum sang that. I don't know who.

ctx.x: And you could play by ear though?

Yeah. Well you see my uncle would hum the thing and he'd say well this goes like this and he'd play and I'd learn it like that. But I also was running the popular tunes of the day, with stop arrangements. What song was popular then? I'll tell you one song that was very popular, I'll never forget, was Long Ago and Far Away. My uncle still has that music now. What's it about? Long Ago and Far Away, the hit parade, number one on the hit parade. It was, I mean it's not no jazz numbers. It's somebody like Judy Gollum…
